profile.jobTitle: Founder | Marketing Technology & Business Systems Integrator | Fractional CMO
profile.summary:
I connect marketing, technology, creative execution, and business operations to help organizations work efficiently, present themselves professionally, and support sustainable growth.

My experience spans healthcare, manufacturing, professional services, associations, nonprofits, and B2B and B2C organizations, with particularly deep experience in healthcare marketing, communications, education, and digital delivery.

For more than 30 years, I have translated complex services, specialized knowledge, and business goals into effective marketing, content, digital platforms, and connected operational systems. As a former printing company owner, I bring firsthand experience in leadership, operations, production, client service, and the evolution from print to digital.

As a Digital Transformation Consultant, Fractional Chief Marketing Officer, and hands-on Marketing Technology and Business Systems Integrator, I work from strategy through implementation. I identify operational gaps, organize disconnected processes, and personally build and connect the websites, platforms, automations, and workflows organizations depend on.

I do not simply recommend systems or hand the work to an outside team. I help determine what is needed, build it, connect it, document it, and support its continued use.

My capabilities include:
• Marketing and growth strategy
• Business systems integration and process improvement
• Websites, SEO, and e-commerce
• CRM, email, forms, payments, and automation
• Branding, messaging, graphic design, and content
• Social media, analytics, and reporting
• Customer onboarding and lead workflows
• SaaS positioning and product launches
• Webinars, virtual events, and online education
• SOPs and platform administration

Graphic design is an important capability I bring, but it is not the limit of my role. I combine creative judgment with marketing leadership, technology, operations, and hands-on implementation.

In healthcare education and SaaS, I have built and managed systems supporting certifications, continuing education, webinars, digital products, and recurring campaigns. My responsibilities have included registration, payments, virtual training, evaluations, certificates, CRM integration, automation, websites, customer communications, and compliance workflows.

My work has helped generate more than $2 million in annual revenue, increase engagement by 30%, achieve 75% advertising revenue growth, double website traffic, improve campaign conversions by 10%, and streamline workflows by as much as 50%.
